question: “A History of British India” is a work Published by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**James Mill.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **James Mill**

 
 
• ​**“A History of British India” is a work Published by James Mill.**
 
• James Mill was a **Scottish historian, economist, political theorist, and philosopher **who lived from **6 April 1773 to 23 June 1836**.
 
• He is one of the founding members of the **Ricardian school of economics**.
 
• He was one of the famous **historians who adopted a colonial viewpoint**, and he also produced The History of British India (1817).
 
• He was the first author to divide Indian history into three distinct periods: **Hindu, Muslim, and British.**
 
• This division has proven to be extremely influential in the field of Indian historical research.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A History of British India**

 
 
• **​James Mill,** a Scottish historian, economist, political theorist, and philosopher, chronicled the history of Company rule in India in his three-volume masterpiece **The History of British India.**
 
• When it was initially **published in 1817,** the book was an immediate hit and brought Mill "**a measure of affluence**."
 
• In accordance with the prominent **political forces and their religious ties**, Mill divided Indian history into the **Hindu, Muslim, and British periods**.
